```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a scatter plot for Income vs Age with hue for Education
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Age', y='Income', hue='Education', alpha=0.7, palette='viridis')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Income vs Age Colored by Education Level', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Education Level', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
